dialog.english:
We made it to Karigaoka in one
piece.
dialog.translation:
Hemos llegado a Hikarioka de
una pieza.

dialog.english:
Good thing the bus dropped us off
here.
dialog.translation:
Menos mal que el bus nos ha
dejado aquí.

dialog.english:
Matt, T.K, that was an
amazing performance!

"It was the last place we could be
happy together before our parents
divorced..."
dialog.translation:
"Fue el último sitio donde fuimos
felices juntos antes de que
se divorciaran..."

dialog.english: Even I totally believed it!

But the camp bus wouldn't drop us
off here unless we said that.
dialog.translation:
Pero el bus no nos dejaba
aquí sin decir eso.

dialog.english:
The Karigaoka apartment complex
is huge! It's like a castle!
dialog.translation:
¡El bloque de Hikarioka es
enorme! ¡Parece un castillo!

dialog.english:
It's not a castle. All kinds of
different people live separately
in those apartments.
dialog.translation:
No es un castillo. Viven
personas distintas por separado
en esos apartamentos.

dialog.english: Huuuuuuh?!
Humans are so interesting!

Did you live in Karigaoka too,
Sora?
Yeah.

Sora and I were in the same class.
Third Elementary School, class
1-2!
dialog.translation:
Sora y yo íbamos a la misma
clase. ¡Colegio Tercero, clase
1-2!

dialog.english: I went to Fourth Elementary.
I went to Fifth...
Me too! I was in kindergarten...

So was I! It was only for a short
time, though...
dialog.translation:
¡Yo igual! Aunque fue solo
por poco tiempo...

dialog.english: Whaaaaaat?
*All* of us lived in Karigaoka?

I don't think this is just a
coincidence.
dialog.translation:
No creo que esto sea
una coincidencia.

dialog.english:
Anyway, back to Myotismon. He's
already made the first move.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, volviendo a Myotismon.
Ya ha dado el primer paso.

dialog.english: Maybe not...

What makes you think that,
Izzy?

The flow of time is different
between the two worlds. If
Myotismon came here...
dialog.translation:
El tiempo pasa distinto entre
los dos mundos. Si Myotismon
vino aquí...

dialog.english:
...only a minute or so should have
passed between his arrival and
ours.
dialog.translation:
...solo habrá pasado un minuto
entre su llegada y la
nuestra.

dialog.english: Oh!

So if we hurry, we might beat
Myotismon's army to the eighth
child?
dialog.translation:
Si nos damos prisa, ¿quizá
lleguemos al octavo niño
antes que su ejército?

dialog.english: Okay, let's look for them!
PicoDevimon, Tailmon, take this.
Ah!
Go on! Take it!
Hmph! So patronizing. What's this?

It's a copy of the eighth child's
Crest.
dialog.translation:
Es una copia del Emblema del
octavo niño.

dialog.english: What about the real one?

It's in my possession. But the
copy will still react if the
eighth child is near.
dialog.translation:
Lo tengo yo. Pero la copia
reaccionará igual si el octavo
niño está cerca.

dialog.english:
You must find the eighth child at
any cost.
dialog.translation:
Debéis encontrar al octavo niño
como sea.

dialog.english: Yes, sir!
Yes, sir!

You might not remember it well,
T.K, but we used to play a lot
around here.
dialog.translation:
Puede que no lo recuerdes bien,
T.K., pero jugábamos mucho
por aquí.

dialog.english:
But it still feels pretty
nostalgic.
dialog.translation:
Pero aun así da bastante
nostalgia.

dialog.english:
How long did you live here,
Izzy?
I believe it wasn't even a year.
dialog.translation: Creo que no llegó ni a un año.

dialog.english:
Must have been because of that
terrorist bombing.
dialog.translation:
Debió de ser por aquel
atentado terrorista.

dialog.english: Bombing?
Terrorists?

You guys might not remember this,
but there was a terrorist attack
here four years ago.
dialog.translation:
Puede que no os acordéis, pero
aquí hubo un atentado
terrorista hace cuatro años.

dialog.english:
They never caught the culprit, so
my parents moved away. They
thought it was too dangerous here.
dialog.translation:
Nunca cogieron al culpable, y
mis padres se mudaron. Creían
que esto era peligroso.

dialog.english:
Right, it was the same for my
family. They said something about
a bombing.
dialog.translation:
Es verdad, a mi familia le pasó
igual. Dijeron algo de un
atentado.

dialog.english:
Come to think of it, I feel like
something similar happened with my
folks.
dialog.translation:
Ahora que lo pienso, creo que a
mis padres les pasó algo
parecido.

dialog.english: Huh?

Ah! Is that one of Myotismon's
Digimon?
That's Mammon!
This is bad! We have to stop him!
Ahahaha! We did it!

People can actually see Myotismon's
Digimon...
dialog.translation:
La gente ve los Digimon
de Myotismon...

dialog.english: Giant monsters...
What'd you say, T.K?

I remember! Back when we lived 
here, T.K got scolded for 
saying he saw giant monsters!
dialog.translation:
¡Ya me acuerdo! ¡Cuando vivíamos
aquí, regañaron a T.K. por
decir que vio monstruos!

dialog.english: Could that have been...
...the so-called bombings!

This is definitely where the
terrorist bombings took place!
dialog.translation:
¡Aquí es donde pasaron los
atentados terroristas seguro!

dialog.english: It felt exactly like this!

Yeah. They were fighting, then
this and that happened...
dialog.translation:
Sí. Estaban luchando, y pasó
esto y aquello...

dialog.english:
(What I saw that day...wasn't a
giant monster.)
dialog.translation:
(Lo que vi ese día no era
un monstruo gigante.)

dialog.english: Koromon... Koromon, what happened?
W-whoa...
*sob* Koromon... Koromoooooooon!
Koromon...
Kari, gimme your whistle!
Tai?
Get him!

Greymon! That's right, it was
Greymon!
You're right...

That day, a Koromon came to our
home, and that Koromon became an
Agumon.
dialog.translation:
Ese día, un Koromon vino a
nuestra casa, y se convirtió
en Agumon.

dialog.english:
And then it became a Greymon, and
fought with another Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Y luego se convirtió en Greymon,
y luchó contra otro Digimon.

dialog.english:
After the fight, they both
disappeared...
dialog.translation:
Tras la pelea, los dos
desaparecieron...

dialog.english: So it wasn't a terrorist attack!

So you met Tai back then,
Koromon?

It must have been a different
Koromon!

But when I first met Tai, I had
this really nostalgic feeling...
dialog.translation:
Pero cuando conocí a Tai, sentí
algo muy nostálgico...

dialog.english:
This is bad! We're gonna get
caught, and they're gonna ask a
lot of questions!
dialog.translation:
¡Esto es malo! ¡Nos van a pillar
y nos harán un montón de
preguntas!

dialog.english: R-ruuuuuun!

*pant* *pant* I think we're far
enough.
Yeah.
I always thought it was strange.

Out of all the children who went
to camp, why were we the only ones
chosen?
dialog.translation:
De todos los niños del
campamento, ¿por qué fuimos los
únicos elegidos?

dialog.english:
But today, we've found the key to
this mystery.
dialog.translation:
Pero hoy hallamos la clave
de este misterio.

dialog.english:
The incident from four years
ago...
dialog.translation:
El incidente de hace
cuatro años...

dialog.english:
Yes. What we have in common is
that we all met the Digimon four
years ago.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Tenemos en común que todos
conocimos a los Digimon hace
cuatro años.

dialog.english: So the eighth child did, too?

I'm sure they must have seen the
incident.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que también vio
el incidente.

dialog.english:
So does that mean Myotismon's
already found them? They're in
Karigaoka, right?
dialog.translation:
¿Entonces significa que
Myotismon ya lo ha encontrado?
Está en Hikarioka, ¿no?

dialog.english:
Since Mammon was wandering around
here all alone...
dialog.translation:
Si Mammon andaba dando vueltas
por aquí solo...

dialog.english:
...the others are all prolly
wand'rin' around lookin' for the
eighth child!
dialog.translation:
...¡los demás deben de andar
por ahí buscando al
octavo niño!

dialog.english:
We'll find them! We'll find the
eighth child before they do!
dialog.translation:
¡Encontraremos al octavo niño
antes que ellos!

dialog.english: But where do we look?

There's one other thing we have in
common...
dialog.translation:
Hay otra cosa que tenemos
en común...

dialog.english: We all moved from Karigaoka...

Yes. It can't be a coincidence, so
we should assume that the eighth 
child has also moved.
dialog.translation:
Sí. No puede ser casualidad, así
que el octavo niño también
debió de mudarse.

dialog.english: So the eighth child is in Odaiba?
I wanna go hooooooome!

All right! In that case, let's
head back to Odaiba!

Why is there an elephant in
Karigaoka?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué hay un elefante en
Hikarioka?

dialog.english:
They must be making a movie, or
something!
Aaaaaaaaaaah!
Gyaaaaaaah!

Tai! We have to do something
about Mammon, right now!
dialog.translation:
¡Tai! ¡Hay que hacer algo con
Mammon, ahora mismo!

dialog.english: You're right, let's go!
Let's go!
Yeah!
Roooooooooar!
All right, Koromon! Evolve!
Got it!
Koromon, evolve!
Agumon!
Over here!

I'm pretty sure I just saw a
monster!
